scene.geometry: analytical rigid rotor with explicitly assigned inertia; no collision geometry

run.processes: two independent OS processes for each case/variant
run.sampling: t0 and every post-step state; command for step n evaluated at t_n=n*dt then held for that solve; command arrays indexed by n have 800 rows, state/status arrays have 801 rows
run.finite_policy: all physical and command samples finite including t0; all post-step statuses finite; only status sample0 may contain constructor placeholders

reference.equations: With I=1, h=dt, D=I+h*kd+h*h*kp: v_next=(I*v+h*(kp*(qref-q)+kd*vref_used))/D; q_next=q+h*v_next; tau=I*(v_next-v)/h. POSITION uses vref_used=0 even when a nonzero target_qd is supplied; POSITION_VELOCITY uses supplied target_qd. Formula is unsaturated and is not clipped; force-margin acceptance must independently validate that assumption.
reference.derivation: Backward evaluation of spring displacement and damping: tau=kp*(qref-q-h*v_next)+kd*(vref_used-v_next); I*(v_next-v)=h*tau. This equals bounded effort row interior with m_a=h*kd+h*h*kp, not continuous-PD forward Euler.
reference.implementation: Independent float64 scalar recurrence in analyzer, no Newton imports. Derive I from archived COM inertia/mass/COM using parallel-axis theorem. Save reference.npz per run as analysis output, separate from raw simulation NPZ.
reference.body_reference: Expected body position stays at origin; quaternion represents rotation about Y, angle independently recovered using 2*atan2(qy,qw), no wrap within these targets. Compare this body angle to joint_q and scalar reference.

criteria_rationale: q/v reference thresholds are 0.5% of 0.1rad and 0.3% of the sinusoidal peak target velocity. 0.002Nm is 0.02% of effort limit and rejects wrong mode/sign/implicit denominator. Margin >=4Nm means all outputs stay <=60% of the 10Nm finite limit; the reference is un-clipped and must also meet it. Body at COM avoids translation drift confounding scalar dynamics. Stability envelope 0.2rad/1rad/s is broader than inputs but rejects runaway. Tolerances are frozen before simulation and are not convergence residual thresholds.

cases.title: 非饱和隐式PD：正负位置目标与中途反向
cases.schedule: qref=sign*0.1rad for step0..399; qref=-sign*0.1rad for step400..799; target_qd=0 throughout
cases.metric_definitions: Endpoint samples400 and800 compared with the target held during preceding step. Within each constant-target segment E=.5*I*v^2+.5*kp*(q-target)^2 must not increase by >1e-5J per step; exclude the target-jump pair400->401 from this check. Mirrored A/B trajectories q and v must sum to zero within stated tolerances.
cases.rationale: kp25 kd10 I1 gives critically damped continuous limit with 0.2s time scale; 2s dwell leaves ample room for 2% endpoint accuracy while the entire transient still must match the implicit recurrence. Target reversal checks sign, memory and nonzero state response.
limitations: Single critically damped gain setting and fixed dt, not universal PD tuning
Mirror comparison is symmetry evidence; scalar recurrence supplies independent correctness evidence

cases.title: 动态目标与速度参考语义：POSITION_VELOCITY 对 POSITION
cases.schedule: For step n at t=n*dt, qref=.1*sin(pi*t)rad and supplied target_qd=.1*pi*cos(pi*t)rad/s in BOTH variants; POSITION must ignore this velocity reference while retaining kd damping.
cases.metric_definitions: Tracking RMS uses state samples401..800 versus command samples400..799 (target held for corresponding step), one complete final period after 2s startup. Relative improvement=1-rmse_A/rmse_B. Report full-run tracking RMS and peak error as secondary metrics; every sample still must match its mode-specific independent recurrence.
cases.rationale: At 0.5Hz below the natural frequency 5rad/s, using consistent velocity reference should reduce tracking lag. Bounds .03/.08rad and >=30% relative improvement are intentionally looser than the continuous transfer-function estimates (~.02/.067rad RMS), but actual acceptance is against the discrete reference and frozen absolute gates.
limitations: One smooth frequency/amplitude only; no claim of arbitrary-bandwidth tracking
Comparison tests target-mode semantics, not solver backend ranking

convergence_diagnostics.report: post-step converged fraction, iteration max/distribution, max and terminal residuals; report exact frozen 1e-7 thresholds and 200 budget. Also compute whether all post-step statuses converged as a separate diagnostic boolean; it does not decide physical acceptance.
convergence_diagnostics.interpretation: No claim of solver convergence solely from trajectory agreement. No claim of numerical floor or root cause from residual magnitude. Initial status0 is not a solved dynamics result.

provenance: Every attempt gets a new run ID; retain failures, raw NPZ, resolved configs, protocol and runner copies plus SHA256, logs, source-lock SHA and all 809 installed locked Python source SHA checks. No selecting favorable repeat or widening thresholds. Pure harness fixes require parent approval and new runner hash; physical revisions need a newly frozen protocol.
limitations: Newton1.7.0 pinned commit only, CPU singleworld dense PADMM
Only bounded implicit PD interior; saturation and runtime limit changes belong to separate experiments
Private state/config reads are observational instrumentation, not supported user API
reviewed_by: root: source equations, observable distinctions, independent-reference gates and no post-run threshold changes
